Mark Jeffrey Radford was born on July 5, 1959.
Mark Radford is an American former National Basketball Association player.
Mark Radford played from 1981 to 1983.
Mark Radford played college basketball for Oregon State University from 1977 to 1981.
Mark Radford was drafted in the third round (53rd overall) of the 1981 NBA draft by the Seattle SuperSonics.
Mark Radford played in 97 career games over two seasons for the Seattle SuperSonics.
Mark Radford's career high was 22 points, 5 rebounds, 7 assists, 4 steals, and 2 blocks.
Mark Radford had a career average of 3.6 points, 0.8 rebounds, 1.7 assists, 0.5 steals, 0.1 blocks, and 1.2 turnovers.
Mark Radford has two children named Armin and Nina.
Nina went on to play collegiate basketball for Northern Arizona University.
